provenance.selection_rationale: Before any model responses were collected, the candidate provider panel was re-frozen to models with provider-documented zero-cost API access because the study has a hard experimental compute/API budget of USD 0. This was not performance-driven and no model result had been observed.

zero_cost_execution_policy.credential_storage: Codespaces Secrets or an equivalent uncommitted secret store only

preflight_requirements: GEMINI_API_KEY and GROQ_API_KEY must be present without printing their values.
The account tier, billing-disabled state, exact model availability, image-plus-text capability, and current rate-limit metadata must be verified live before any request.
Exactly one multimodal capability-pilot request per model is permitted only after the registry status becomes FREE_ONLY_PILOT_AUTHORIZED.
A 429 or quota-exhausted result must be recorded as FREE_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED and must stop that provider; it never authorizes payment.
The main benchmark is forbidden until the three pilots succeed at no monetary cost and the registry is newly frozen as FREE_ACCESS_VERIFIED_EXECUTABLE.

models.privacy_disclosure: Google documents that Free Tier content may be used to improve its products. Benchmark inputs are limited to controlled simulation scenes and public or structured research evidence; no credentials or private personal data may be sent.

models.account_specific_caveat: Google currently documents that access to Gemini 2.5 models may be limited to accounts that have actively used them previously. A live model-availability check is mandatory; no replacement may be made after benchmark execution begins.
